summary: Frontend-only testing of CL Messenger admin system. All 8 features tested successfully: Console tab in Settings, /login command, /logout command, /status command, admin bot visibility, regular user bot hiding, /sub command access control, and bot/channel creation limits.

console_tab.description: Console tab in Settings modal opens correctly. Shows CL Console v1.0 with available commands: /help, /status, /login, /logout, /logs, /clear

login_command.description: /login hhsqs000091demyan_icqToCLxd successfully authenticates as admin. Shows green success message '✅ Успешный вход! Вы теперь администратор.'

logout_command.description: /logout command successfully exits admin mode. Shows confirmation and reverts status to regular user

status_command.description: /status shows current user status (🔒 Обычный пользователь or 🔓 Администратор), username, and stars balance

admin_bot_visibility.description: Admin-only bots (Отладочный Бот/Debug Bot, Gift Bot, Config Bot) are visible when logged in as admin

regular_user_bot_hiding.description: Admin-only bots are correctly hidden from regular users. mockData.js correctly marks them with adminOnly: true flag

sub_command_admin_only.description: /sub command in Fun Channel shows '❌ Команда /sub доступна только администраторам!' for regular users. Admin can successfully change subscriber count.

creation_limits.description: Create Contact form shows 'Лимиты обычного пользователя: Боты: 0/5, Каналы: 0/5' for regular users. Admin sees no limits message.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All admin features working. Admin code: hhsqs000091demyan_icqToCLxd. Set localStorage 'cl_user_registered' to true to skip registration. Admin status stored in 'cl_admin_status'.

mocked_apis_list: All data is stored in localStorage - no backend API calls
